extra._note: Name is a placeholder. PRD Open Questions: a confrontational name is a design flaw, since an officer may be reading this screen.

plugins.microphonePermission: Kavach records the encounter so your words are not lost, and so a lawyer can see what happened. Recording is always visible on screen.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Kavach includes where you are in the alert it sends to your trusted contacts, so somebody knows where to find you. Location is only read when you send an alert.
